invoice (distinct_count 2330), stockcode (distinct_count 3141) and invoice_date (distinct_count 2004) are all null_rate 0.0 and together identify one order line after exact duplicates are collapsed; a reviewer must measure this against the warehouse because the profile cannot rule out a product appearing twice on one invoice.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and describe the load, not the sale, so none reach silver.

quantity samples are integral between min -1395.0 and max 5184.0, customer_id samples are integral between min 12346.0 and max 18287.0, and price samples carry at most two decimals up to max 1998.49, so the landed DECIMAL(38,9) narrows to INTEGER, INTEGER and DECIMAL(10,2) respectively.

quantity min is -1395.0 and the sampled values are all negative, showing a return or cancellation population inside the same table; is_return_line surfaces it as a boolean so consumers filter deliberately instead of discovering negative sums.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned order-line table for the online retail transactions landed in bronze.online_retail_ii: one row per invoice line, with capture metadata removed, exact duplicate rows collapsed, timestamps and numerics typed, and return lines flagged. It feeds downstream sales, product and customer aggregates.
usage: Read one row as a single product line on a single invoice, keyed by invoice, stockcode and invoice_date. Filter is_return_line deliberately: quantity ranges from -1395 to 5184 and negative lines represent returns or cancellations, so any revenue or volume measure must decide whether to include them. Join to customer dimensions only after filtering customer_id is not null, since about 30 percent of lines have no customer attached, and treat description as a free-text label rather than a join key.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 of 45228 rows) are collapsed, but the profile cannot prove that invoice plus stockcode plus invoice_date is unique in the remaining rows; the declared grain must be measured against the warehouse before approval. customer_id is null on 13468 rows (null_rate 0.29778) and description on 228 rows (null_rate 0.005041); both are retained as null and nothing is imputed. Description text keeps its landed leading and trailing whitespace, stockcode keeps its mixed alphanumeric form, and no currency or country normalisation is applied even though country has only 24 distinct values.
